name: Wildcard Draconic Aspect shows the dracthyr form, not the pig fallback (#11081)
contract: Draconic Aspect 280600 transforms into creature 379386 (SPELL_AURA_TRANSFORM). The database had no such creature, so the transform used the missing-template pig display 16358.
The form creature now carries the Pyromancer Draconic Aspect display 142067. Casting (3 s) shows 142067, and the native display returns when the aura ends.

steps.label: THE FIX (#11081): the dracthyr display, not the pig
